as_told.title: ODNI DIG and James Erdman's Senate testimony on reprisals against whistleblowers

plain: In 2026, a former official is said to have told Congress that the CIA spied on government whistleblowers, including people who had come forward about UFOs. The official had headed a group working under Tulsi Gabbard, the US intelligence chief. Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who investigates UFOs, relays it simply: "They found out the CIA was spying on the whistleblowers." He mentions names around the story, including Luis Elizondo, Jay Stratton and the reporter George Knapp. A guest named Dylan Borland names the man who testified as James Erdman III and says he spoke before the Senate. Borland says the testimony covered what was done to whistleblowers on UFOs and also on COVID and on "anomalous health incidents", the unexplained illnesses reported by some US officials, which would mean the agency watched people who tried to speak up.
